notes.title: Bug Hunting Partner Needed!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/0KwfZWJ/file-Source.png[/img]

Have you run into a bug with [i]CRASH: Autodive [/i]where the screen is orange/brown and you can't see anything?  Then I need your help to fix it!

I've gotten a few bug reports for this insidious bug and I can't reproduce it to be able to fix it.  The only path forward is to find someone who is having this issue who is willing to work with me to help get it fixed.  I would need to send you builds of the game and you would need to run them and send me back log files. This would probably happen several times as I try different things until we can fix it.

As a reward, you'll get your name in the credits and if you're in the USA, some [i]CRASH: Autodrive [/i] swag!

Thanks and ping me at info@studionightcap.com if you are interested!

David
